title: What it takes to solve the Hubble tension through modifications of cosmological recombination II: in light of ACT DR6 and DESI DR2
efc_relevance: Maps the data-allowed recombination-modification space using ACT DR6 + DESI DR2; defines the upper boundary on any pre-recombination modification consistent with current data. EFC keeps standard recombination, so the paper's posterior is the explicit constraint that EFC's H0 resolution must respect (no shift of the sound horizon).
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as L1/L2 sound-horizon invariance constraint; cross-reference framework:EDE-Poulin2019, arXiv:2604.26541 (ACT DR6 IDR + α_s) and arXiv:2605.05691 (E(z) reformulation); required explicit statement in P7 (H0 three-window) that EFC's resolution preserves r_s.
